Monologue: Aijinkova's soldiers are being moved en masse towards Verehn. Svetka plans to put me in charge of public safety in this city, after Izolda's… talk.
There is still no cure for the Spoilage. There was a doctor making progress, but he is gone. I do not wish to know where.
Naturally, she expects me to find a way to blame the rebels for the Spoilage. And then bravely expose my insensate ferity for doing so, perhaps?
It's not hard to guess her intent when you've been coworkers for so long. Maybe that's why her employees keep jumping ship.
Use me as a mask to wipe out the Spoiled, just as she used Izolda to wipe out the nobility. How long until she's canonized as a saint?
Svetka has already garnered enough foreign pity to arm Verehn. And now? Izolda scared her, so I have to suffer through their paranoia.
I've realized that I can't live in a world where that bastard is smiling. I hate her. She is cruel, if that motivates you.
Ignore me. If her cruelty were a deterrent, you wouldn't support her like this. No one would.
